comments.subject: Public Comments Form
comments.comment:
To Whom it May Concern:

I am writing to inform you that I am strongly against the city building a skate park in the Little Valley park area. I live in the neighborhood that backs up to the park. We do not want to lose our green grass, park and quiet space to enjoy with our families. It is a nice cool oasis in the hot summer months. A concrete skate park will take away from that. A skate park will destroy the beauty and serenity of that area. It is a nice place for families to enjoy the grass and park, walk their dogs and ride bikes. A skate park will bring increased traffic (we already deal with the pickelball courts, volleyball courts, soccer fields, etc.)

There was no public input I believe on this concept and I believe that is not acceptable. I have lived there for over 15 years and have enjoyed the park and that area tremendously and do not want to see the area we enjoy replace with concrete and noise.

I am a big NO on a skate park in Little Valley. There is no place for that. Who do we contact in the city to have a public forum on this?

Respectfully,

Karen Cutchen

notes: Single JotForm submission opposing a skate park in Little Valley.
